metadata.description: A judge for persuasive political messages, built for a progressive messenger: it scores a message or a series of messages against a rulebook drawn from movement messaging research, and turns each finding into a concrete rewrite suggestion

plugins.name: message
plugins.description: Scores persuasive political messages against a fourteen-axis rulebook, using TypeSafe's Jev system to judge each rule and each message as a whole, and produces concrete suggested rewrites for the weakest spots. The judge skill, invoked as /message:judge, takes a message, a file of messages, or a whole site, and works through a fetch, card-writing, scoring, and suggestion-verification pipeline.
